corrections.reason: The final character on L24 is 'ከ', which wraps to 'መ' on L25 to form the canonical Ge'ez conjunction 'ከመ' ('ከመ መኑ ውእቱ ወልድ', Luke 10:22), matching the parallel clause in L28.
Classical Ge'ez perfective verb 'ወሐለፉ' ('and they passed by / departed', Luke 10:30) uses first-order 'ሐ', visually confirmed on the page.
